purpose: Teach: 人様/見合っ/ヶ国/すぐさま/助長/覆っ/ほかなら/乗せる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、人様の自転車に勝手に乗るなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't just borrow people's bikes without asking.
lines.style: Direct reprimand, older-sibling edge. Sharp attack on his name. Firm but not angry—the tone of someone stating a fact he should already know. Brief, conclusive.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、彼女と目が見合って照れてたな、桜
lines.en: You were totally blushing when she looked at you, Sakura.
lines.style: Playful accusation, knowing smirk underneath. Casual rhythm, slight elongation on the observation. Teasing her back—not mean, just turning the tables. Quick and light.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で世界二百ヶ国習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, you studied two hundred countries in social studies, right?
lines.style: Sudden conversational shift—genuine curiosity breaking through. Slower, searching tone. She's testing whether he knows something specific. Slight lift at the end, inviting him to follow.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストでミスにすぐさま気付いてたな、桜
lines.en: You spotted that test mistake right away, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment of something she doesn't expect praise for. Gentle, observational tone. No fanfare—just stating what he saw. Warm but understated, like he's giving her credit she didn't ask for.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、SNSのいじめを助長するなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't spread bullying on social media.
lines.style: Serious warning, no negotiation. Clean, measured delivery. She means it—this isn't teasing. Direct eye contact in the voice. Stern but protective, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、毛布で顔を覆って寝てたな、桜
lines.en: You sleep with the blanket pulled up over your face, don't you?
lines.style: Wry observation, slight amusement threading through. Caught him in something small and oddly specific. Light, almost affectionate mockery. Rhythm is casual, like she's just noticing out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、ほかならぬ憧れの家だな
lines.en: Your place is really something special, isn't it, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine warmth beneath the words. Slower, more sincere than her usual rhythm. She's admitting something she doesn't usually say aloud. Soft attack, lingering on the compliment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車の後ろに弟を乗せるの上手いな、桜
lines.en: You're really good at giving your little brother rides on the back of your bike.
lines.style: Quiet, direct compliment. Warm undertone—she's noticing something kind he does without making a show of it. Steady pace, genuine. No performance, just acknowledgment.
